Class Pic

java.lang.Object
org.cobol4j.Pic
public final class Pic extends Object
Parses and represents a COBOL PICTURE clause.

A PIC clause defines a field's data type, size, and display format. Examples:

  • PIC X(20) — 20-char alphanumeric
  • PIC S9(7)V99 — signed numeric, 7 integer + 2 decimal digits
  • PIC Z(5)9.99 — numeric edited with zero suppression
